title: Choosing the step size
sub: Trace plots: the walker's position over time. Same target, same start at x = −2, three step sizes.

frames.caption: 600 iterations. Almost every proposal is accepted, but each moves a hair. The walker never finds the second bump: it reports 0% in a region that holds 40% of the probability.
600 iterations. Big enough to leap the valley, small enough that many proposals land somewhere plausible. The trace looks like noise, which is what good mixing looks like.
600 iterations. Nearly every proposal lands far out in the tails and is rejected, so the trace is a staircase of long flat runs. Few distinct samples.
